page.subtitle: From emergency repairs to complete property transformations, PSR delivers professional trades services across Greater Manchester. Every job, every trade, one trusted team.
page.ctaSubtitle: Can't see what you're looking for? We handle all types of maintenance and renovation work. Get in touch and let's discuss your project.
page.whatsappMessage: Hi, I have a project and would like to discuss what services you can provide.

general-repairs.title: General Repairs
general-repairs.description: From a sticking door to a crumbling plaster wall — PSR's general repair team handles every small job with the same care as a full renovation. We show up on time, bring the right tools, and leave your home better than we found it. No call-out fees, no hidden charges.

full-renovations.title: Full Renovations
full-renovations.description: Whether it's a full kitchen refit, a loft conversion, or a whole-house renovation, PSR manages every stage — design, trades coordination, materials, and finish. One point of contact, one team, zero stress. We've transformed properties across Greater Manchester for over 12 years.

plumbing.title: Plumbing
plumbing.description: PSR's plumbing team covers everything from a dripping tap to a full heating system installation. All our plumbers are fully qualified and Gas Safe registered where applicable. We offer emergency call-outs across Greater Manchester, 7 days a week, with a response target of under 2 hours.

electrical.title: Electrical Work
electrical.description: All electrical work at PSR is carried out by Part P certified electricians, ensuring every installation is safe, tested, and fully compliant with current BS 7671 wiring regulations. From a single socket to a full consumer unit upgrade, we issue the correct certification on completion.

painting-decorating.title: Painting & Decorating
painting-decorating.description: PSR's decorating team delivers clean, lasting paintwork on new builds, period properties, and commercial spaces across Greater Manchester. We prep properly — filling, sanding, priming — so the finish holds. No runs, no missed patches, no shortcuts.

tiling-flooring.title: Tiling & Flooring
tiling-flooring.description: PSR's tiling and flooring team works to a standard you can see in every grout line. We handle everything from a single bathroom wall to a whole-house floor installation — wall tiles, floor tiles, large format porcelain, underfloor heating, and all hard flooring types.

plastering.title: Plastering
plastering.description: PSR's plasterers deliver the flat, flawless surface that makes a room. Whether you need a full re-skim after a renovation, dry lining for a new partition, or patch repairs after pipework — we work quickly, cleanly, and to a standard ready for paint the next day.

maintenance-plans.title: Maintenance Plans
maintenance-plans.description: PSR's maintenance plans keep your property in peak condition with scheduled inspections, seasonal checks, and priority access to the full trades team. Ideal for homeowners who want peace of mind, and landlords who need compliant properties with minimal hassle.
